lede: mcproof is a domain where models produce proofs and checkers, judged by deterministic programs. Models propose. They never approve.
howto: This page is a proof: numbered claims, tiers and evidence, recomputed by two independent checkers. Break the graph and the seal turns red.
mixer: Colour comes from Eido: style as a draggable point. Its first position derives from the claim graph hash.
axioms: Four stated commitments. Disagree with them by name.
baseline: Specs, oracles and layers 2 to 5 exist and were run. The end-to-end claim is T0, still a conjecture.
obligations: Five open goals stand between the baseline and T0. While any is open, T0 stays CONJECTURE.
hazards: Seven seams where proof, prose and style could corrupt each other, each with its guard.
verify: Run the gates yourself: two checkers, twelve planted bugs, a byte-identical rebuild. No proof, no publish.
